description: Tangible Real-World 3D Objects Spatial Scroll Canvas (Cassette, Floppy, Keycap, Polaroid, Mug)

userStories.title: Build procedural 3D Retro Audio Cassette Tape model
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see an authentic 3D cassette tape with spools, tape window, and label floating in space instead of abstract shapes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Three.js Group with cassette chassis, beveled center cutout, and winding spools
Generate 2D CanvasTexture label with 'NEHAL // SIDE A - DEV TRACKS'
Realistic PBR materials with clear polycarbonate and magnetic brown tape
userStories.notes: Built with clear acrylic body, rotating hubs, tape roll, and labeled canvas

userStories.title: Build procedural 3D Floppy Disk and Mechanical Keycap models
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want tactile developer objects: a 3.5-inch floppy disk and an artisan mechanical keyboard keycap.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 3.5-inch floppy disk with metallic sliding shutter, corner notch, and label
Create mechanical switch housing with cross stem and DSA keycap
Apply authentic materials (matte black plastic, brushed metal, PBT)
userStories.notes: Built floppy with brushed aluminum shutter and keycap with frosted switch + red stem

userStories.title: Build procedural 3D Polaroid Photo Print and Ceramic Coffee Mug
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a physical Polaroid print with drop shadow and a minimal developer coffee mug.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Polaroid photo card with textured white border and photo print face
Create ceramic coffee mug with hollow opening and side handle
Materials reflect paper sheen and glazed matte ceramic
userStories.notes: Built photo print with handwritten caption and glazed ceramic mug with coffee surface

userStories.title: Integrate real-world objects into SpatialScrollCanvas with scroll trajectory
userStories.description: As a user, all real-world objects should glide, tilt, and rotate smoothly as I scroll through the portfolio.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace all abstract shapes (spheres, icosahedron, toruses) in SpatialScrollCanvas with real-world objects
Orchestrate positions: Cassette in Hero, Floppy in About, Keycap & Polaroid in Projects, Mug near Contact
Smooth scroll lerp and mouse parallax inertia applied to all objects
userStories.notes: Choreographed spatial paths across all sections with pointer parallax and lerp
